description: Own homage to the Belgian Rodania car jingle, as heard from a roof loudspeaker: synthetic trumpet plays the opening motif of Beethoven's 5th (G G G Eb, public domain), then a resynthesised voice sings 'Ro-da-ni-aaa' on the same notes. Not a copy of the Rodania recording.
license: Own work (CC0-1.0 dedication possible); melody: Beethoven, public domain; sung voice derived from Piper nl_BE-nathalie-medium (CC0 dataset)
attribution: Own synthesis for this project (numpy + WORLD vocoder + ffmpeg).
